name: Aura Farm Edit Tower [🎵]
desc:
🎀ASMR Tower is a relaxing tower obby packed with satisfying ASMR sounds, including slime squishes, soft squeezes, and keyboard clicks. 🎧

⚡Climb your way to the top while enjoying calming sound effects with every jump and step. From buttery slime and squishy textures to crisp keyboard clicks, every 👟stage is designed to create a soothing and satisfying experience.

🎧Whether you're here to relax, complete the tower, or simply enjoy the ASMR, there's something satisfying waiting at every level.
